title: Mujhe Baba ka Sar
body:
bhaiya sajjad
ye meri aakhri shab hai sakina ne kaha bhaiya
mujhe baba ka sar laa do
<<DIVIDER>>
sakhi ke laal ho ye aakhri khwahish na radh karna
tumhare ghar ka shewa ghareebon ki madad karna
sawali hai jale daaman ko phailaye huwe dukhiya
mujhe baba ka sar laa do
ye meri aakhri shab hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
padar ke baad beti ka tamachon par guzara hai
bataungi unhe shimr e layeen ne kaise maara hai
zara nazdeek se aa kar wo mera dekhle chehra
mujhe baba ka sar laa do
ye meri aakhri shab hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajab haalat may dekha tha sar e darbar baba ko
nahi pani mayassar qaid khane may sakina ko
mai apne aansuon se dho'ungi mazloom ka chehra
mujhe baba ka sar laa do
ye meri aakhri shab hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai royi jab padar ko shimr ne badla liya tum se
qasam hai mujhko baba ki mera waada raha tum se
sakina na ab na royegi na ab khaoge tum durra
mujhe baba ka sar laa do
ye meri aakhri shab hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
zuban hai khushk itni baat karna mujhpe bhari hai
tumhe maloom hai bhai sakina kab se pyasi hai
magar karti nahi dukhiya taqaza tum se pani ka
mujhe baba ka sar laa do
ye meri aakhri shab hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
padar ka dekh kar chehra sada bedaar hoti thi
shab e ashoor tak unki ziyarat kar ke soti thi
zara dekho in aankhon ne unhe kab se nahi dekha
mujhe baba ka sar laa do
ye meri aakhri shab hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
pareshan ho agar koi tasalli dete jaate hai
suna hai marte dam apno se milne ko wo aate hai
hai mujhpe nazha ka aalam chali mai chod kar dunya
mujhe baba ka sar laa do
ye meri aakhri shab hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
takallum sar jab aaya qaid khane may qayamat thi
adhoori reh gayi baatein hui khamosh shehzaadi
faza may goonjta hai shadman ab tak yehi nauha
mujhe baba ka sar laa do
ye meri aakhri shab hai...
author: Mir Takallum
